basic_details.job_title: Central University of Odisha Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Registrar & Controller of Examinations Posts

application_fee.details: Application fee must be paid online via net-banking, debit card, or credit card through SBI Collect. The SBI e-challan must be submitted along with the application form. The fee once paid is non-refundable and non-adjustable.

age_limit.details: For Direct Recruits, the age limit is preferably below 57 years. The date for determining the age, qualification, and experience shall be the closing date for receipt of application (20.11.2026). | Relaxation in age and qualification shall be applicable to SC, ST, OBC, and PWD candidates as per GoI rules and amendments issued from time to time.

qualification.details: Eligible Indian citizens can apply for the posts on direct recruitment or deputation basis.

selection_process: The selection will be based on interview

as applicable under Cadre Recruitment Rules of the University - 2022. Mere fulfillment of required qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The University reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to a reasonable limit based on higher qualifications and experience as decided by the Screening Committee.
how_to_apply: Access the SBI Collect portal at the official SBI online payments website and select State Bank Collect.
Select State as 'Odisha' and Type of Category as 'Educational Institutions', then click 'Go'.
Select the Name of the institution as "CENTRAL UNIVERSITY OF ODISHA" and payment category as "Non-Teaching Recruitment Application Fee".
Enter applicant details, pay the required application fee online, and print the SBI e-challan/receipt.
Download and fill out the prescribed application form enclosed with the advertisement.
Attach self-attested supporting documents pertaining to age, category, educational qualifications, experience, and the SBI e-challan.
Superscribe the envelope as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Post Name] against Advt.No. 01/2026 dated – 07.10.2026".
Send the completed application by Registered Post to “The Registrar I/c, Central University of Odisha, P.O.: NAD, Sunabeda, Koraput – 763004” on or before 20.11.2026 at 17:00 Hrs.
important_instructions: Applicants already in Central / State Government / PSU / Autonomous Institution services must submit their application through proper channel along with a vigilance clearance certificate and No Objection Certificate. Separate applications along with requisite fees must be submitted by candidates applying for more than one post. Appointments shall be governed by the National Pension System (NPS) as applicable to Central Autonomous Bodies joining on or after 01-01-2004. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Any canvassing, suppression of factual information, or supply of fake documents will lead to outright disqualification. Jurisdiction for any legal proceeding shall be restricted to the Hon’ble High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: i) Master’s degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. ii) At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level 11 and above or with 8 years of service in the Academic Level 12 and above including as Associate Professor along with experience in educational administration; OR Comparable experience in research establishment and/ or other institutions of higher education; OR 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent Post. Deputation: Qualifications & Experience as indicated above. Grade: Holding analogous post or eight years’ experience at Pay Level-12.

faq.question: Q1. What is Central University of Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a non-teaching recruitment notification (Advt. No. 01/2026) inviting applications for the posts of Registrar and Controller of Examinations on direct recruitment or deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Central University of Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 unreserved vacancies are available, with 1 post for Registrar and 1 post for Controller of Examinations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Central University of Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of completed applications along with supporting documents is 20 November 2026 at 17:00 Hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Registrar and Controller of Examinations?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree with at least 55% marks, plus specified years of academic experience as an Assistant Professor, comparable research experience, or 15 years of administrative experience including 8 years as a Deputy Registrar or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for direct recruits?
faq.answer: The age limit for direct recruits is preferably below 57 years as of 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General, OBC, and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 2000.00 for General, OBC, and EWS candidates, while female, SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should I submit the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their duly filled application form along with self-attested documents and SBI e-challan through Registered Post to The Registrar I/c, Central University of Odisha, P.O.: NAD, Sunabeda, Koraput – 763004.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for these posts?
faq.answer: Both Registrar and Controller of Examinations positions are in Level 14 of the pay matrix (Rs. 1,44,200 – 2,18,200) as per the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an interview for selection?
faq.answer: Yes, the selection will be based on an interview of short-listed candidates conducted as per the Cadre Recruitment Rules of the University - 2022.
